x: Ruby is corundum (aluminium oxide, Al2O3) coloured red by trace chromium replacing some aluminium ions. Iron and titanium give blue sapphire; manganese, cobalt and silver are not the ruby colourant.
source: notes row-30 sub 9 (gem table); Britannica 'ruby' (corundum + chromium)

x: India's ravines are concentrated in the Chambal–Yamuna basin on the southern fringe of the Gangetic plain (Chambal ravines of MP, Rajasthan, UP). Narmada valley and the Shivaliks (chos) have local gullies, but the bulk of ravine land lies on the periphery of the Ganga plain.
source: OnlyIAS NCERT Indian Geography 06 (ravines notably in the Chambal basin); PMF Environment 05 (Chambal Valley ravines)
